description: Live prediction market odds from Polymarket and Kalshi, most traded first. Each market's outcomes is a list of {outcome, price}, the price being the implied probability (0 to 1). Pick the venue and a topic (crypto by default); partial, with meta.diagnostic.missing naming the venue, when a venue fails, has no markets or does not cover the topic.

topic.description: crypto (default), bitcoin, ethereum, solana, any Polymarket tag slug, or all for no filter. Kalshi covers the four crypto topics only.

venue.description: polymarket, kalshi or all (both, the default).

name: get_prediction_markets
